findings.comment: Required zoning district setback lines are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan, grading plan, or landscape plan for the northern, eastern, and southern property boundaries. Only the western boundary (Valley View Road) shows a labeled platted setback. All required yard setback lines for the MF-2 zoning district must be clearly drawn, labeled, and dimensioned on the site plan.

Compliance with zoning district setback distances cannot be verified because required setback lines are not shown with dimensions from property boundaries to buildings. No dimensions are provided on the site plan, grading plan, or landscape plan showing the distance from building faces to the northern, eastern, or southern property lines. Provide dimensioned setback lines for all property boundaries with required setback values clearly labeled.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary adjacent to SF-3 zoning
findings.comment: Article 10 compatibility standards applicability has been incorrectly determined. The site is zoned MF-2, which is less restrictive than MF-4, and is located adjacent to an SF-3-zoned property. SF-3 is SF-5 or more restrictive and qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053. If the development is within 75 feet of this SF-3 property boundary, Article 10 compatibility standards apply. The applicant marked 'No' on the consolidated application for compatibility standards applicability, but this appears to be incorrect. Clarify whether the southern boundary is within 75 feet of the triggering property, and if so, prepare a compatibility analysis and revised plans demonstrating Article 10 compliance.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary adjacent to SF-3 property
findings.comment: If Article 10 compatibility is triggered (site within 75 ft of SF-3 triggering property), the required compatibility buffer is not shown at the correct width along the shared property line. The compatibility buffer must be 25 feet wide (or 15 feet if the development site is less than 75 feet wide measured from the shared triggering property line), shown as a landscaped zone complying with § 25-8-700 planting requirements, and extending along the full length of the property line shared with the triggering property. No such labeled and dimensioned buffer line appears on the site plan or landscape plan.

Triggering property or properties are not clearly identified on the site plan compatibility sheets with all required information. While the site plan vision analysis identified adjacent zoning labels (SF-3 on south), there is no separate compatibility exhibit clearly labeling the triggering property with its zoning designation (SF-3) and dwelling unit count (required to confirm it qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053). Prepare a compatibility exhibit showing the triggering property location, zoning, and dwelling unit count, and clearly label it on all relevant plan sheets.

Separate compatibility exhibit is not provided or is incomplete. If Article 10 compatibility is triggered, the required standalone compatibility exhibit must show: property boundaries, on-site and off-site zoning boundaries (including all triggering properties and applicable combining districts), distances from triggering property boundary to existing and proposed structures, distances to surface improvements (parking, driveways, drainage features), and location of existing structures on triggering properties. This documentation is required to demonstrate compliance with § 25-2-1061 (height limits), § 25-2-1062 (buffer), and § 25-2-1063 (screening).

Transformer pad clearances cannot be verified. Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows transformer locations on the site, but no clearance dimensions or construction details are provided demonstrating compliance with Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4. The criteria require specific minimum clearances based on building construction type (e.g., 12 feet to non-masonry buildings, 5 feet to brick/masonry). Provide a transformer pad detail sheet showing clearance dimensions to all adjacent buildings and structures with notation of building construction type to verify compliance.
